correctness.rationale: The exact time-dependent PGF update follows from an independent new-label hit and binomial post-thinning. For each degree-k nonpositive-root polynomial, nF+(1-x)F_prime has k (if k<n) or k-1 (if k=n) interlacing nonpositive real roots; repeated-root cases follow by approximation and nonnegative coefficient closure. Affine thinning and the x factor preserve the property including boundary p=0 or 1. By exchangeability and Borcea–Brändén–Liggett Theorem 3.8 the full occupancy vector is strongly Rayleigh. For fixed 0<p<1 finite-chain convergence and closure prove stationarity. Exact independent Markov kernel and polynomial checker passed 3960 assertions for n≤6; infinite quantifiers rest on the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The dynamic-loss collector is a motivated random caching/retention process with physically dependent labels. A universal finite-time Poisson-binomial count representation and strongly Rayleigh occupancy invariant strengthen the previously known negative association in a structural, nonasymptotic way, survive arbitrary deterministic common loss schedules and yield access to conditional negative dependence and real-rooted rank tools. This is not a fixed-size exercise, normalizing trick, or merely a new numerical estimate; limits and lack of simple Bernoulli parameter formulas are explicitly stated.
